summary: Tested new IMORA profile editor (backend + frontend). All 8 new profile backend tests pass. All 32 regression tests (test_audit_fixes.py) still pass — no regressions. Full frontend UI flow validated via Playwright: profile-editor renders, all 10 data-testids present, live preview updates in real time, role switching hides pro fields correctly, all 3 validation errors trigger (Nom requis, Numéro invalide, agency required), save succeeds and toast displays.
critical_code_review_comments: ProfileEditor.jsx (444 lines) is close to the 700-line threshold — consider splitting compressAvatar helper and preview card into their own modules if the file grows further.

Bio counter in label uses form.bio?.length (JS string length, counts UTF-16 code units); backend truncates at 500 chars via Python .strip()[:500]. Edge case: emojis in bio could produce different visible counts client vs server, but not a blocker.
Frontend sends role='particulier' when user is admin (line 143 of ProfileEditor.jsx) as a defensive workaround; backend already ignores role for admins — safe redundancy.
seed_data_creation: Restored test-user-agence to baseline (name/agency_name reset) after mutation by tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend profile editor covered by test_profile_editor.py (8 tests). Regression suite audit_fixes.py stays at 32/32. Frontend Playwright scenario in this iteration covers: login via localStorage imora_token, tab navigation, all data-testids, live preview, role gating, three validation scenarios, and save success.
